Let \( a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots \) be the unique sequence of nonnegative integers less than 397 with \( a_0 = 1 \) and

\[ a_{n+1}(a_n + 1)^2 \equiv a_n \pmod{397} \]

for all nonnegative integers \( n \). Given that \( a_{2026} = 9 \), compute the remainder when \( a_0 + a_1 + \cdots + a_{2026} \) is divided by 397.

Put your final answer within \boxed{}.

message.content:
Work modulo \(397\). Since \(397\) is prime, every nonzero residue has a multiplicative inverse.

First note that \(a_n \neq 0\) for all \(0 \le n \le 2026\). If \(a_k=0\) for some \(k \le 2026\), then the recurrence gives \(a_{k+1}=0\), so by induction \(a_{2026}=0\), contradicting \(a_{2026}=9\).

Define

\[
b_n \equiv a_n^{-1} \pmod{397}.
\]

Then \(b_0 = 1\). From

\[
a_{n+1}(a_n+1)^2 \equiv a_n \pmod{397},
\]

multiply by \(a_n^{-1}a_{n+1}^{-1}\) to get

\[
a_{n+1}^{-1} \equiv (a_n+1)^2a_n^{-1} \pmod{397}.
\]

Expanding,

\[
b_{n+1} \equiv a_n+2+b_n \pmod{397},
\]

so

\[
a_n \equiv b_{n+1}-b_n-2 \pmod{397}.
\]

Sum from \(n=0\) to \(2025\):

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2025} a_n \equiv b_{2026}-b_0-2\cdot 2026 \pmod{397}.
\]

Now \(b_0=1\), and since \(a_{2026}=9\),

\[
b_{2026} \equiv 9^{-1} \pmod{397}.
\]

Because \(9\cdot 44 = 396 \equiv -1\), we have

\[
9^{-1} \equiv -44 \equiv 353 \pmod{397}.
\]

Also,

\[
2\cdot 2026 = 4052 \equiv 82 \pmod{397}.
\]

Thus

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2025} a_n \equiv 353-1-82 = 270 \pmod{397}.
\]

Finally, add \(a_{2026}=9\):

\[
a_0+a_1+\cdots+a_{2026} \equiv 270+9 = 279 \pmod{397}.
\]

\[
\boxed{279}
\]
